donor_artifact_policy.recipe_rule: Qualified Synexia recipes and their proof crates may be copied or adapted into target tooling; recipe execution is never a Synexia runtime dependency.
donor_artifact_policy.runtime_dependency_rule: M3JDK21 runtime has no dependency on Synexia modules, services or build tooling.
donor_artifact_policy.target_license_rule: M3JDK21 follows OpenJDK per-file/module licensing and must not blindly commingle license-incompatible source.
donor_artifact_policy.third_party_rule: Third-party material retains its original copyright, license and NOTICE obligations and is never made Apache-2.0 merely by Synexia wrapping, atomization, testing or convergence.
